author: 1v1Me_
body:
Hey guys it me KingR10 and I just had a suggestion I wanted to share with Avicus. I was thinking if you click my name (look at my marvelous KD :D) than click infractions you can see the person infractions. My idea was for when you get warned by a staff member, it show's up on the persons infractions, but only for staff. 

Just an Idea and pls give feed back!
-Zack
